blocks.text: Cache model weights in a named volume at a pre-owned HF_HOME (or bake them in for prod), pin the model revision, warm up at startup, and deliver API keys as secret files.

items: No volume → re-download on every recreate.
Non-root with no writable home → PermissionError.
Fix: `ENV HF_HOME=/models`, create and chown /models to UID 10001 before USER, mount `hf_cache:/models` (a fresh volume inherits the ownership).

model = SentenceTransformer(settings.embedding_model, revision=settings.embedding_revision, device="cpu")
assert model.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() == settings.embedding_dim

blocks.text: Pin a commit hash, not "main": changed weights embed queries differently from indexed vectors, and retrieval silently degrades.

items: Warm up (load + one dummy embed) in lifespan; set a healthcheck start_period to cover it.
Never in Dockerfile, compose.yaml or images; .env and secrets/ in .gitignore and .dockerignore.
Don't log headers or settings; per-environment keys with spending limits.

blocks.text: Q: "How do you handle model weights and LLM API keys in containers?" A: "Weights: pinned revision, a named-volume cache at a pre-owned HF_HOME in dev or baked in for prod, warmed up before reporting healthy. Keys: runtime secret files read into SecretStr, never baked into images or logged, scoped per environment."

items: Pre-own the cache dir; use a named volume.
Keys as secret files, never in images.
